description: This codec compresses Neuropixels voltage recordings (C-contiguous int16 arrays, shape (4096,384), dtype '<i2') losslessly and decodes them exactly. Compression uses a two-stage process: 1) a simple predictive coding step (per-channel delta, i.e., storing differences along time for each channel), followed by 2) standard entropy compression (zlib, bz2, or lzma) selected for best compression per-chunk. The first row of each channel is stored verbatim for reconstruction. The compressed blob stores a header with a mode selector and all necessary metadata for decoding. Decompression uses the shape/dtype arguments and the header to restore the original array exactly. No cross-chunk state, external source info, or learning is used. All prediction and compression steps use reproducible, deterministic logic. The output blob size is minimized while satisfying exact reconstruction requirements.
